description: Finalization and documentation. Write the phased plan document into the repo's plan location matching the existing convention (docs/plans/), documenting Sections 1/3/5/6/2 as implemented and Section 4 (Coretax export) as explicitly DEFERRED with the rationale (format spec unavailable) plus the data-structuring note so a Coretax exporter can be added later. Also add a small forward-compatibility note where transaction data is stored so a future Coretax export mapping has the fields it needs. Update README roadmap if appropriate. NO agent self-attribution anywhere.
steps: Create docs/plans/<yyyy-mm-dd>-trading-refactor-pipeline.md matching the style of docs/plans/2026-06-13-nusantara-erp-implementation.md and docs/PLAN_PARITY_NSA.md: a phased plan mapping the handoff's six sections to the implemented features (FEAT-002 Section 1 pipeline, FEAT-003 Section 3 dashboard/funnel/reporting, FEAT-004 Section 5 dual-view, FEAT-005 Section 6 senior UI, FEAT-006 Section 2 SJ validation minus live email), with per-section status.

Document Section 4 (Coretax Format) as DEFERRED: state that the exact Coretax export spec is unavailable, that the format-specific exporter is out of scope for this pass, and that sales/purchase transaction data is structured/stored so a Coretax export can be added later. Note the specific fields already captured (party, NPWP/tax id if present, tax rate, document number, date, line qty/price/tax) that a future exporter would map.

Add a brief inline code comment near the tax/invoice data structures (e.g. in schema.js or invoice-view.js) noting the Coretax-readiness intent — WITHOUT implementing the format mapping. Keep it a comment/structural note only.
Update README.md roadmap section to reflect the new pipeline/funnel/SJ-validation/dual-view capabilities if it fits the existing style. Do not bump attribution or add the agent as author.
Confirm no self-attribution was introduced anywhere by this task (grep the diff for co-authored-by / agent names / AI credits) and record confirmation in findings.
acceptance_criteria: A phased plan doc exists in docs/plans/ mapping all six handoff sections to status (implemented or deferred).
Section 4 Coretax is documented as deferred with rationale and the data-structuring forward note.
No agent/AI self-attribution appears in any file, commit, or doc.
`npm run lint` and `npm run build` still pass (docs changes are inert).
